text.p: Diametrics Medical Inc said Thursday it completed an $8.0 million private placement of 1,422,222 shares of common stock at $5.625 a share, primarily with European institutional investors.
The purchasers also received warrants to purchase 355,556 shares of common stock at $6.75 a share, providing future funding potential of $2.4 million.
Diametrics said the five-year warrants are callable if the common stock price exceeds $8.75 for 20 consecutive days in the next 12 months and at increasing amounts thereafter.

"This financing, in combination with the private placement we completed in January 1997, will provide most of the funding needed for implementation of our global growth strategy, based on an expanded product line of blood and tissue analysis systems," David Giddings, chairman, said in a statement.
